desc: Derive reduction: ans = Y + Z − 2·min(B, Y, Z), B = max-bottleneck (vertex-min incl. endpoints); verified on sample
I/O layer: bulk `sys.stdin.buffer.read()` parse into numpy grid + query arrays; single joined write
Edge list construction: vectorized horizontal/vertical edges with weight `minimum(F_u,F_v)`, sorted descending
Kruskal reconstruction tree via DSU (path halving), internal node weights = edge weights, leaves = F
Depth (reverse id scan, valid since parent id > child id) + binary lifting table (int32, LOG≈19)
Vectorized LCA over all queries; `ans = Y+Z−2·min(Y,Z,wt[lca])`; same-cell queries give |Y−Z|
Edge cases handled: H=1/W=1, H·W=1 (no edges, LOG≥1), same-cell different-floor; sample yields 10 and 2
Perf path: optional SciPy maximum spanning tree (weights 10^6+1−w, no zeros/negatives) to shrink DSU loop, with pure-Python fallback
